sentences.en: She nodded and said mm-hmm when I told her about my new job.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉她我换了新工作时，她点了点头并发出“嗯哼”的声音。

sentences.en: He was listening intently, making an occasional mm-hmm to show he understood.
sentences.zh: 他专心地听着，并不时发出“嗯哼”声以表示他在听懂了。

sentences.en: I asked if she wanted some tea, and she responded with a mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 我问她要不要喝茶，她用‘嗯哼’回应表示同意。
